info.title: LeadGen - Business

x-seo.description: LeadGen Business API by Melissa. Search and retrieve business lead data with firmographic filtering.

info.description:
## LeadGen - Business Overview ##
LeadGen Business is a dynamic REST-based Cloud API, tailored for selecting, retrieving counts, and acquiring precision-targeted business mailing lists instantly, round the clock. It serves as a versatile resource, accessible to mailers for exclusive in-house utilization or as a convenient portal for your customers, facilitating their list selection process. You have the flexibility to craft a customized website to align with your unique requirements, as well as cater to the preferences of your valued clientele

LeadGen Business can be used to:
- Select
- Get Counts
- Purchase Targeted Business Mailing Lists
- Do any of the above in real-time, anytime

**Documentation**
- [LeadGen Business Documentation](https://docs.melissa.com/reference-data/leadgen-business/leadgen-business-index.html)

**Useful Resources**
- [GitHub - LeadGen Business Open API Specification](https://github.com/MelissaData/MelissaCloudAPI-OpenAPI-Specification/blob/main/openapi/apis/leadgen-business.yaml)
- [Release notes](https://releasenotes.melissa.com/cloud-api/leadgen-cloud-api/)
- [Status codes](https://docs.melissa.com/other/status-codes-index.html)

**Product Page**

[https://www.melissa.com/direct/mailing-lists-sales-leads/leadgen-api](https://www.melissa.com/direct/mailing-lists-sales-leads/leadgen-api)

**Support Center**

[https://www.melissa.com/company/product-support](https://www.melissa.com/company/product-support)

tags.name: Business Service
tags.description: Use Business Service endpoint to request various business service actions.

get.summary: Perform action for a single business
get.description: Uses HTTP GET to accept one input record and returns the response in XML format.

post.summary: Check order (file) status after a buy request
post.description: Uses HTTP POST to accept a URL or OrderId and returns the File Status response in JSON format.

Action.name: action
Action.description:
There are two available actions:
- `get` - Get count of addresses that fit in the given criteria.
- `buy` - Buy a list of addresses' info that fit the given criteria.

GeographicType.name: geographicType
GeographicType.description: The included [Geographic Types](https://docs.melissa.com/reference-data/leadgen-business/leadgen-business-reference-guide.html#geographic-types) are zip, city, county, state, radius, circle, and polygon.

CustomerID.name: id
CustomerID.description: Requester's customer ID or email address

Zip.name: zip
Zip.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: zip
* Optional: radius

Handling: Each five-digit ZIP is validated.

ZipPlus4.name: zip+4
ZipPlus4.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: zip
* Optional: radius

Handling: Plus4 is a filter in data selection.

City.name: city
City.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: city
* Optional: radius

Handling: Each city and state combination is valid

County.name: county
County.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: county

Handling: Each county and state combination is validated. FIPS is retrieved if valid.

State.name: state
State.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: state
* Optional: radius

Handling: Two-digit state code is validated.

Address.name: addr
Address.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: radius

Handling: Exact street number and street name are used in data selection. No validation. Latitude and longitude are retrieved if the address exists.

Mile.name: mile
Mile.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: circle
* Optional: radius
(Mile or record must be given.)

Handling: Mile is used to find out the latitude and longitude of a parameter for many miles away from the given address. For radius type, maximum is 50 miles. For circle type, the radius must be between .025 and 25 miles

Records.name: records
Records.description:
Geographic Type
* Optional: radius
(Mile or record must be given.)

Handling: Number of records that are closest to the given address

Street.name: str
Street.description:
Geographic Type
* Optional: radius

Handling: A street name within the given zip. (The street name needs to be exact.)

StreetZip.name: strzip
StreetZip.description:
Geographic Type
* Optional: radius

Handling: Zip for a specific street that is within the given radius (combination with a given address.)

Point.name: pt
Point.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: circle

Handling: A longitude;latitude point

Points.name: points
Points.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: polygon

Handling: Each set of points for a polygon is validated and reoriented in the sequence of drawing.

SIC.name: sic
SIC.description:
Meanings: Append 6- digit SIC code to file if exists

Default: sic=0

To Append: sic=1

SIC-d.name: sic-d
SIC-d.description:
Meanings: Various SIC codes as selection/filter

Default: all inclusive

To Append: Otherwise specify the SIC's (2 to 6 digits), use '-'' dash to specify multiple SIC codes, i.e. sic-d=17-9999-729924

Staff.name: staff
Staff.description:
Meanings: Append number of employees to file

Default: staff=0

To Append: staff=1

Staff-d.name: staff-d
Staff-d.description:
Meanings: Various sizes of staff as selection/filter
  1. 1 - 4
  2. 5 - 9
  3. 10 - 19
  4. 20 - 49
  5. 50 - 99
  6. 100 - 249
  7. 250 - 499
  8. 500 - 999
  9. 1,000 - 4,999
  10. 5,000 - 9,999
  11. 10,000

Default: all inclusive

To Append: Otherwise specify the index; use '-' dash to specify multiple staff codes, i.e. staff-d=6-8-10

Sale.name: sale
Sale.description:
Meanings: Append annual sales volume to file

Default: sale=0
To Append: sale=1

ContactTitle-d.name: contacttitle-d
ContactTitle-d.description:
Meanings: Various ContactTitle as selection/filter

Default: all

To Append: use ‘,’ comma to specify multiple contacttitles

contacttitle-d=1,2,3

Title-d.name: title-d
Title-d.description:
Meanings: Various Title as selection/filter

Default: all

To Append: use ‘,’ comma to specify multiple titles

title-d=DDS,DPT

One.name: one
One.description:
One contact per business

Default Value: one=1

Optional Output Parameter: one=0 returns all contacts

Dbug.name: dbug
Dbug.description:
Parameter check. If a parameter is spelt wrong or not suited for the given call, the request will be rejected.

Default Value: dbug=0

Optional Output Parameter: dbug=1 to check

Name.name: name
Name.description:
Append contact name and gender to file if exists

Default Value: name=0

Optional Output Parameter: To append: name=1

Po.name: po
Po.description:
Customer's purchase order number

Default Value: none

Optional Output Parameter: To specify: po=xxxx

Multi.name: multi
Multi.description:
By default, purchased lists may be used once. With this parameter included in the Buy call, you can purchase the right to use a list for multiple mailings. Specify the number of uses like this: multi=4. The maximum number of uses allowed for any purchased list is 5.

Default Value: multi=1

Optional Output Parameter: multi=(1 through 5)

File.name: file
File.description:
Defines the desired file format of a purchased list.

Default Value: file=8

Optional Output Parameter:
- `2` - File Format: Zipped .txt
- `3` - File Format: Zipped .csv
- `5` - File Format: Zipped .xls (Excel)
- `7` - File Format: .txt
- `8` - (Default) File Format: .csv
- `10` - File Format: .xls (Excel)

Fax.name: fax
Fax.description:
Append fax number (if available)

Default Value: fax=0

Optional Output Parameter: fax=1

Phone.name: phone
Phone.description:
Append phone number (if available)

Default Value: phone=0

Optional Output Parameter: phone=1

NAICS.name: naics
NAICS.description:
Append 8-digit NAICS code to file if exists

Default Value: naics=0

Optional Output Parameter: naics=1

NumEmp.name: numemp
NumEmp.description:
Appends the number of actual employees (as opposed to a range like staff)

Default Value: numemp=0

Optional Output Parameter: numemp=1

KeyExec.name: keyexec
KeyExec.description:
Appends the Key Executive to file

Default Value: keyexec=0

Optional Output Parameter: keyexec=1

NumSales.name: numsales
NumSales.description:
Appends the estimated sales volume in thousands (as opposed to a range like sale)

Default Value: numsales=0

Optional Output Parameter: numsales=1

TransmissionReference.description: Serves as a unique request identifier.

TransmissionResults.description: Lists error codes from any errors caused by the most recent request as a whole.

Address.description: Requests within Geo Selects. Tags returned depend on Geo type.

Options.description: Requests within Geo Selects. Tags returned depend on Geo type.

NumberOfEmployees.description: Number of employees of the business

IncludeAll.description: Default output is <IncludeAll>True</IncludeAll>, unless details options are specified in request. For example, <Details>100 - 249;500 - 999;5,000 - 9,999</Details> would be shown with all chosen options separated by semi colon

AnnualSalesVolume.description: Various ranges of annual sales volumes

StreetRange.description: Contains a breakdown of the street range.

StartNumber.description: For Geo types radius. Shows the starting street number in the count.

EndNumber.description: For Geo types radius. Shows the starting ending number in the count.

TotalCount.description: Total number of records returned with the selected options.

Count.description: Location of count detail. The location varies by the request type

Result.description: Indicates the status of a request. Returns Declined, Approved, or Err.

Url.description: Download link provided from the buy request.

OrderId.description: OrderId provided by the buy request.

type.description: The type of error that occurred.

title.description: A short summary of the error.

status.description: The HTTP status code for the error.

$.<PropertyName>.description: A detailed message about the error.

traceId.description: A unique identifier for the request, useful for debugging.
